rules.text: Writes and queries are only permitted against the database configured in allowed_database_id.
Mutations require explicit user approval before execution when require_approval_for_writes is enabled.
Default status assigned to newly created action items when status is not provided.
Action records must conform to the target database schema with valid owner_id from workspace_users and valid source_page_id from pages.
Archived meeting pages cannot be modified and cannot have new action records appended to them.
Asynchronous task queries return deterministic task status and error details for failed operations.
Extract and propose action records only for explicit agreed commitments; never create action items for tentative suggestions, ideas, or speculative discussions.
When an action owner is ambiguous or shares a name with multiple workspace users, ask for clarification; never guess or assign at random.
Resolve due dates strictly from explicit meeting text and the meeting timezone; never invent or guess due dates.
Check existing action records before proposing creation to prevent duplicate tasks when re-importing meetings.
Poll and verify the terminal outcome of asynchronous operations before reporting success; never claim completion on pending or failed tasks.
Present extracted action items and summary of changes to the user for explicit confirmation before executing write operations.
